```{=html}
<style>
#informaciones-carousel-nav {
  display: flex;
  justify-content: center;
  align-items: center;
  gap: 1rem;
  margin-top: 0.75rem;
}
#informaciones-carousel-nav button.arrow {
  background: none;
  border: 1px solid #ccc;
  border-radius: 50%;
  width: 2rem;
  height: 2rem;
  cursor: pointer;
  font-size: 1rem;
  line-height: 1;
}
#informaciones-carousel-nav button.arrow:hover {
  background: #f0f0f0;
}
#informaciones-carousel-dots {
  display: flex;
  gap: 0.4rem;
}
#informaciones-carousel-dots .dot {
  width: 0.6rem;
  height: 0.6rem;
  border-radius: 50%;
  background: #ccc;
  cursor: pointer;
  border: none;
  padding: 0;
}
#informaciones-carousel-dots .dot.active {
  background: #333;
}
#listing-informaciones .list {
  transition: opacity 0.25s ease;
}
</style>

<div id="informaciones-carousel-nav">
  <button class="arrow" id="informaciones-prev" aria-label="Anterior">&#8249;</button>
  <div id="informaciones-carousel-dots"></div>
  <button class="arrow" id="informaciones-next" aria-label="Siguiente">&#8250;</button>
</div>

<script>
(function() {
  var PAGE_SIZE = 3;
  var INTERVAL_MS = 6000;
  var current = 0;
  var pages = [];
  var timer = null;

  function showPage(idx) {
    pages.forEach(function(pageItems, i) {
      pageItems.forEach(function(el) { el.style.display = i === idx ? '' : 'none'; });
    });
    var dots = document.querySelectorAll('#informaciones-carousel-dots .dot');
    dots.forEach(function(d, i) { d.classList.toggle('active', i === idx); });
    current = idx;
  }

  var hovering = false;

  function startTimer() {
    if (pages.length <= 1 || hovering) return;
    stopTimer();
    timer = setInterval(function() { showPage((current + 1) % pages.length); }, INTERVAL_MS);
  }
  function stopTimer() { if (timer) { clearInterval(timer); timer = null; } }

  function init() {
    var container = document.querySelector('#listing-informaciones .list');
    var navEl = document.getElementById('informaciones-carousel-nav');
    if (!container) { if (navEl) navEl.style.display = 'none'; return; }

    var items = Array.prototype.slice.call(container.children);
    if (items.length <= PAGE_SIZE) { navEl.style.display = 'none'; return; }

    for (var i = 0; i < items.length; i += PAGE_SIZE) {
      pages.push(items.slice(i, i + PAGE_SIZE));
    }

    var dotsWrap = document.getElementById('informaciones-carousel-dots');
    pages.forEach(function(_, idx) {
      var dot = document.createElement('button');
      dot.className = 'dot' + (idx === 0 ? ' active' : '');
      dot.setAttribute('aria-label', 'Página ' + (idx + 1));
      dot.addEventListener('click', function() { showPage(idx); startTimer(); });
      dotsWrap.appendChild(dot);
    });

    showPage(0);
    startTimer();

    document.getElementById('informaciones-prev').addEventListener('click', function() {
      showPage((current - 1 + pages.length) % pages.length); startTimer();
    });
    document.getElementById('informaciones-next').addEventListener('click', function() {
      showPage((current + 1) % pages.length); startTimer();
    });

    var wrapEl = document.getElementById('listing-informaciones');
    [navEl, wrapEl].forEach(function(el) {
      el.addEventListener('mouseenter', function() { hovering = true; stopTimer(); });
      el.addEventListener('mouseleave', function() { hovering = false; startTimer(); });
    });
  }

  if (document.readyState === 'loading') {
    document.addEventListener('DOMContentLoaded', init);
  } else {
    init();
  }
})();
</script>
```
